seed_memories.content: SqliteStore is the per-request storage layer in rein; it owns a single rusqlite Connection, a Tantivy singleton cache, and the HNSW index handle, and is constructed once per recall request via from_conn.
Recipe note: braised short ribs work best when seared hard, then deglazed with red wine and finished in a 300F oven for three hours.
Birthday card sketch for Alex: watercolor of the lighthouse at Pemaquid Point, with a stamped envelope from the maritime museum gift shop.
